title: Former Dean Ronald Caltabiano Commits $1.1 Million to Jordan College of the Arts to Support Innovative and Experiential Arts Initiatives
summary_en: Butler University announced today a $1.1 million estate commitment to the Jordan College of the Arts (JCA) from Ronald Caltabiano, who served as Dean of JCA from 2011-2016. The gift will create a discretionary endowed fund for the dean to support innovative and experiential arts  initiatives and other top academic priorities within the College, further…
author: jennifer gunnels
